subject.title: [Feature] Allow configuring Gemini safety settings in OpenClaw

question: Should OpenClaw expose a first-class Gemini safety-settings contract, and should it be a Google-plugin-owned setting rather than a generic provider-level field for every `google-generative-ai` compatible endpoint?
rationale: Current main lacks the feature, while the former implementation branch is closed unmerged and the choice determines a persistent public configuration and safety-policy contract.

options.title: Sponsor a scoped Google contract
options.body: Add a strict Google-owned safety-settings schema, documented supported values, adapter-scoped injection, and explicit request-value precedence.

options.title: Use existing generic request parameters only
options.body: Keep the core config surface unchanged and document the supported provider-specific request-parameter path if it can safely express this without new aliases.

options.title: Decline the configuration surface
options.body: Retain upstream Gemini defaults and close the request only after documenting why operator tuning is outside OpenClaw’s supported contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a scoped Google contract
recommendation.body: Add a strict Google-owned safety-settings schema, documented supported values, adapter-scoped injection, and explicit request-value precedence.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent ownership signals cover both the Google transport and the model-provider configuration boundary involved in this decision.
